name: builder-pulse
description: Builder progress telemetry and submitted-prompt learning feedback.

interface.shortDescription: See builder state without interrupting them.
interface.longDescription: Builder Pulse reports only from explicitly enrolled project folders: member-confirmed project name and stable ID, an optionally labeled feature, coarse state, capped active interval, optional cumulative numeric Codex token totals, and secret-redacted bounded primary prompts for GrowthX learning feedback. Folder paths remain local. Separate command, path, transcript, assistant-response, source, and tool-I/O hook fields are never sent.
defaultPrompt: Use Builder Pulse to show the current builder state.
